SPECIAL ABILITIES: Beatdown (ex) [phase i] Whenever struck by a melee attack as a counter attack, the Gold Dragon will return one claw strike at 3d6+21 points of damage. During Phase II, increase damage to 4d6+21

Gigavolt (su) [phase i] Once every 1d3+1 rounds as a standard action, Gold Dragon can charges up and shoots out a charged bolt towards its target or a 60-ft. radius of lightning centered shock wave from its self. The single target shot does 15d10 points of lightning damage or the radius blast does 10d10 points of lightning damage per target, a Reflex save for half damage (DC 26). A blue mage may learn this ability as an 8th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 31). During Phase II, reduce cooldown to 1d2+1 rounds.

Magic Resistance (ex) [phase i] All magical spells and effects only deal 1/2 of their total damage except for water and lightning magical damage to Gold Dragon. This however does not interfere with Runic Guard.

Runic Guard (su) [Begins Phase II] Once below 50% health (380), This Burst Mode lets Gold Dragon guard against most magic spells, making it impossible to hurt him with magic. For a number of rounds equal to 1 + 1 round for every four HD, Gold Dragon gains a permanent Semi-Runic effect absorbing all spells with a 50% chance within 240-ft.-range of him and increases his Spell resistance to 30. This however doesn't effect SU abilities and summoner spells. This limit break requires only a swift action to activate.

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
